response.original_title: {{~!FAQ*s™/Advisor@!}} How do I add a passenger to my MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruises booking, call MSC Cruises Customer Service at +1-877-619-8065 (US) +44-289-708-0062 (UK) (if you booked directly) or contact your travel agent/advisor. Booked directly with MSC: Call the MSC Cruises Contact Center at +1-877-619-8065 (US) +44-289-708-0062 (UK). To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruises reservation, contact MSC Cruises Customer Service at +1-877-619-8065 (US) +44-289-708-0062 (UK) or reach out to your travel advisor directly. Additions cannot be completed through the MSC website or mobile app.
